title: Result Assessment Readiness v1
description: Machine-readable readiness gate that records whether a formal result_assessment is currently allowed for an experiment/series. It deliberately does NOT decide which model or approach is better; it only records readiness_status, result_assessment_allowed, comparison_ready, the open blockers, and an anti-overclaim allowed/disallowed claim boundary. Form is validated here; semantic rules (blocked/ready consistency, three-flag boolean coupling, open/blocking blocker evidence, mandatory disallowed claims incl. absence_of_regressions, claim overlap, evidence path existence/escape, partial-runtime-gate coupling, challenge_version existence) are enforced by scripts/docmeta/validate_result_assessment_readiness.py.

readiness_status.$comment: Semantic rules: 'blocked' requires result_assessment_allowed=false and comparison_ready=false; 'ready' requires result_assessment_allowed=true, no open/blocking blocker, and no referenced partial runtime gate; comparison_ready=true requires readiness_status=ready and result_assessment_allowed=true.

basis.$comment: Free-form supporting counts/context. Not semantically enforced here.

blockers.$comment: May be empty only when readiness_status != blocked. A blocked artifact must carry at least one open blocker (enforced by the validator).

disallowed_claims.$comment: Mandatory anti-overclaim list. Must include the baseline non-claims enforced by the validator: model_quality, comparative_superiority, condition_effect, outcome_upgrade, adoption_readiness, promotion_readiness, production_readiness, security_readiness, absence_of_regressions, external_model_independence.

repoRelativePath.$comment: Repo-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, drive letters and backslashes are rejected here; parent-escape ('..') and symlink-out-of-repo are rejected semantically by the validator with a stable rule id.
